items.text_en: Workaway and WWOOF listings, work exchanged for food and basic accommodation.
items.text_hr: Oglasi na Workaway i WWOOF, rad u zamjenu za hranu i osnovni smještaj.

items.text_en: Soil scientists, foresters, beekeepers, dry stone builders, hydrologists. Especially anyone who has removed Aleppo pine at scale.
items.text_hr: Pedolozi, šumari, pčelari, suhozidari, hidrolozi. Osobito svatko tko je uklanjao alepski bor u većem opsegu.

items.text_en: Institutions, associations and funders working on karst restoration, dry stone heritage or island agriculture.
items.text_hr: Institucije, udruge i financijeri koji rade na obnovi krša, suhozidnoj baštini ili otočnoj poljoprivredi.

items.text_en: Write to Marko Boško. Say which of the five workstreams interests you.
items.text_hr: Piši Marku Bošku. Napiši koja te od pet linija rada zanima.
